definitions.explanation: A medical treatment that filters waste and excess fluid from the blood when the kidneys can no longer do so. Usually refers to {人工透析|じんこうとうせき} (artificial dialysis).

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧{透析|とうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: He gets dialysis three times a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腎臓|じんぞう}→腎臓：13953_jinzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧し、{透析|とうせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧になった。
examples.english: His kidney function declined, and he came to need dialysis.

examples.japanese: {透析|とうせき}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧や⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Dialysis patients need to be careful about managing their diet and fluid intake.

notes:
